info.title: API.SH: Etherscan
info.description: The Etherscan API from API.SH: public Etherscan data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.summary: Fetch a past response again, free
get.description: The exact response a call returned, for 30 days after the call, at no cost. Use the call's x-request-id. Supports output=csv|ndjson.

200.description: The stored response (headers: x-refetch: 1, x-original-time, x-original-route).

404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

get.description:
Everything the Etherscan address page shows: balance and its USD value, coin price, name tag (ENS or public label), contract flag, token holdings value and count, multichain portfolio value, latest and first transaction sent, the address that funded it, total transaction count, the latest 25 transactions (hash, method, block, time, from/to with labels, direction, amount, USD value, fee, gas price), the latest 25 internal transactions and every token holding across chains (chain, token, contract, portfolio share, price, amount, USD value). The full transaction history beyond the latest 25 is not available.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/etherscan-address

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: A 0x address (40 hex characters) or an explorer address link.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

overview.transactions_sent: Latest: 5 days ago First: 11 yrs 34 days ago

get.description:
One block: timestamp, status, transaction and internal transaction counts, withdrawals, fee recipient (address and label), block reward, gas used and its share, gas limit, base fee, burnt fees, size, hash, parent hash, state root, extra data, slot and epoch, plus every detail row under `details`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/etherscan-block

parameters.name: number
parameters.description: Block height or an explorer block link.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

details.transactions: 181 transactions and 49 contract internal transactions in this block

get.description:
The latest blocks, 25 per page, newest first: number, slot, epoch, time, transaction and blob counts, fee recipient, gas used and share, gas limit, base fee, reward and burnt fees. Pass `next_page` back as `page`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/etherscan-blocks

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The gas tracker: standard, fast and rapid gas prices in gwei with base and priority fee, USD cost and confirmation time, the cost of common actions (swap, NFT sale, bridging, borrowing) at each speed, and the top gas spenders over 3 and 24 hours.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/etherscan-gas

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
What the explorer's search box suggests for a keyword: tokens, addresses, name tags, labels and websites, with title, group, address, link, price, website, verified flag, reputation and logo.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/etherscan-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Keyword, address or name (up to 68 characters).

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Limit to one kind of result (default all).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
An ERC-20 token page: name, symbol, standard, decimals, max total supply, holders and the holder change, price in USD and in the chain coin with its 24h change, on-chain and circulating market cap, contract, official site, description, market data (24h volume, market cap, circulating supply), social and data links. A contract that is not a token answers 404.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/etherscan-token

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Token contract address or an explorer token link.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

example.name: Tether USD
example.description: Tether gives you the joint benefits of open blockchain technology and traditional currency by converting your cash into a stable digital cur…

get.description:
The holders of a token, largest first, 25 per page: rank, address, name tag, category label, quantity and USD value, with the holder breakdown tables on page 1 (top cohorts, holder tiers, value thresholds) and the total holder count. Pass `next_page` back as `page`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/etherscan-token-holders

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: Etherscan ERC-20 transfers of an address
get.description:
The ERC-20 token transfers in and out of an address, newest first, 50 per page: transaction hash, method, block, time, from and to (address and label), direction, amount, USD value and the token (contract, name and symbol, logo). The site lists the newest 5,000 transfers. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; it is null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/etherscan-token-transfers

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: A 0x address or an explorer address link.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The token tracker list, 50 per page: rank, name, symbol, contract, price in USD and in the chain coin, 24h change, 24h volume, circulating and on-chain market cap, holders and holder change. Sortable like the site. Pass `next_page` back as `page`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/etherscan-tokens

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The richest accounts, 25 per page: rank, address, name tag, contract flag, balance, share of supply and transaction count. Pass `next_page` back as `page`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/etherscan-top-accounts

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One transaction as Etherscan shows it: status, block and confirmations, timestamp, from and to (address, label, contract flag), value and USD value, fee and USD fee, gas price, gas limit, gas used and its share, EIP-1559 fees, burnt fees, nonce, position in block, transaction type, input data (decoded function and arguments when the contract is verified) and every ERC-20 transfer inside it (from, to, amount, token contract, name, symbol), plus every detail row of the page under `details`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/etherscan-transaction

parameters.name: hash
parameters.description: Transaction hash (0x + 64 hex characters) or an explorer tx link.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
